chapter: Leaving Dinah Shore and his daughters
title: Fathering three daughters outside marriage and deciding to search for them
summary: He admits his weakness for women and decides to look for the three daughters in Los Angeles, Montreal and Newark.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You know, I had a wonderful experience while I was in California, you know? As I said, my first marriage broke up after 25 years, and I got married to my psychiatrist, who was my wife, Iris -- she was a psychiatrist and social worker, but she used to sit and work with me when I was going through my problems. But one thing -- I was laying in bed and I thought about it; you know, I said in the beginning that I wasn't a bad who could drink and when I smoked marijuana, it used to put me to sleep.
So my vice was the girls. I loved the ladies, and during all these escapades that I had, there was a
little -- I fathered lady who had three daughters ... is it all right to talk about this?
Two by your first wife? Was that two?
Two by my first wife and three on the outside by three different mothers.
Yeah, I had five girls all together.

And so I was laying up in bed one day, and it dawned on me that I should go and look for my three daughters. Now I an idea where they were; one was in California -- Los Angeles, and one was in Montreal, Canada, and one was in Newark, New Jersey. Now where in these towns, I didn't know, but I knew that this was where they were conceived at.
